note: Versions, commits and image identifiers of every system under test and every tool image used by the experiments in the paper. Image IDs marked 'archive' are verified by reproduction/reproduce.py load. IDs marked 'build log' are the short IDs printed by docker build on the documented host; those images are not in the archive and must be rebuilt (see README.md, Setup step 4).

host.machine: Apple M5 Max, 18 CPUs, 64 GiB, macOS (arm64)

vms.r5g-claude: 6 vCPU, 12 GiB: main rerun, held-out, delay one seed, delay three seeds, clean rerun, kill timing, orphan/cross-UE recipes
vms.r5g-claude-ran: 4 vCPU, 8 GiB: OAI RAN, free5GC (gtp5g built here), from-source rebuild, before/after-fix cohort, organic chains, impact, free5GC orphan
vms.r5g-reproduction: 4 vCPU, 4 to 8 GiB: fresh-validation cohort and the earlier package's smoke test

build_base.content: Ubuntu 24.04 toolchain with the e85748e source tree built (cached)

rebuild_from_source.id_source: build logs of workspace/build/rebuild/job_rebuild.sh and job_rebuild2.sh
rebuild_from_source.note: the rebuilt SMF binary has the same SHA-256 as the archived one

patches.uac-wait-2000ms: UE-side harness patch in every image: the UAC check waits 2000 ms instead of 100 ms (sed in workspace/testbed/docker/ueransim/Dockerfile*)
patches.gnb-sctp-survive (p2): workspace/testbed/docker/ueransim/gnb-sctp-survive.patch: the gNB survives AMF SCTP loss, releases UE contexts locally and redoes NG Setup every 2 s

r5g/ueransim:4f45e18 and :4f45e18-p1.note: stock gNB that aborts when the AMF dies (used by the main rerun and the stock-gNB arms)

r5g-rebuild/ueransim:4f45e18-p2.note: same commit and patches as r5g/ueransim:4f45e18-p2; used by the organic, thousand-UE, impact and free5GC-orphan runs

free5gc.compose: workspace/testbed/exp/f5g_orphan_compose.yml (orphan experiment), workspace/testbed/free5gc/ (next-use control; upstream free5gc-compose files with their bundled test certificates)

gtp5g.note: kernel module built and loaded in the r5g-claude-ran guest (kernel 6.8.0-117); it must be reloaded after every VM restart

ran.capture_filter: not port 27017 and not port 9090 and not tcp port 4043

tools.python: 3.9 or newer, standard library only (the runs used CPython 3.15 on the host)

package_manifests: reproduction/manifests/*-packages.tsv list every installed package of the archived images; reproduction/manifests/images.json and image-archive.json hold the image IDs and the archive hash
